The '''Sayblohn system''' was located in the [[Quess sector/Legends|Quess sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sayblohn]], and was plagued by a local [[Unidentified pirate group (Sayblohn)|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="RPG" />
